title: Non-European Mathematics Manuscripts: Multilingual Translation Drafts and Modern LaTeX Sources
version: 2026-05-29 multilingual non-European current release: selective repair overlay and reader recombination
description:
Current multilingual non-European mathematics release for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record is organized by language and corpus, with combined reader PDFs for quick browsing and individual work PDFs for direct download.

Status at a glance.

  • Reader surface: [##########] 66 top-level PDFs: combined readers, work-level translation drafts, original-language modern LaTeX drafts, and reference scans/texts.
  • Editable sources: [##########] 214 TeX files plus component PDFs, OCR/review notes, page-image working material, source PDFs, and provenance packets in ZIP artifacts.
  • Latest quality refresh: [#########-] selected newer multilingual repair outputs have been promoted where they improve the current reader surface; newer local Arabic-font repairs and complete reference scans are retained where they are stronger than the candidate replacements.
  • Proofreading/final edition status: [----------] working drafts for checking and continuation, not certified critical editions.

The top-level PDFs use human-readable filenames and begin with an ordering number: the index and combined readers first, followed by work-level translation readers, original-language readers, and historical reference readers. ZIP files contain TeX/source material, source PDFs or scans where appropriate, OCR text, page images, review notes, manifests, audit outputs, and provenance packets.

Workflow. Source scans and reference texts are collected, converted into TeX drafts, checked into readable PDFs, and published with source artifacts for inspection and correction. Readers are welcome to suggest better scans or missing texts. This release is draft work for checking and continuation, not a proofed critical edition.
